description: SPARA gold dataset (20 questions, Option 3 split: 10 simple_address / 6 edge_case / 4 constraint_filtering). All questions address-anchored on real ODEN records from DeSO 0180C5810 (Stockholm). Authoring loop: plan-eil-v3.md Phase 1 Step 1.1. v1.0.1: Q013 wording re-anchored with explicit reference year 'As of January 2026' to eliminate the 2032 verdict-flip risk (plan-eil-v4.md Issue 7).

questions.question: What is the heated area (Atemp) of the building at Loviselundsvägen 81?
expected_facts: heated area (Atemp) is 270 m²
the building is at Loviselundsvägen 81
questions.notes: Step 0.5.2 baseline. ODEN single_filter on epc_idadr → 1 row (byggnadsid 01-80-BERBERISEN7-1). Routes: SQL database → generic_sql_agent → ODEN building_by_address. Walkthrough A passed 10/10 on both runs.

questions.question: What year was the building at Astrakangatan 180 built?
expected_facts: the building at Astrakangatan 180 was built in 1957
questions.notes: Anchor: byggnadsid 01-80-AVKOPPLINGEN4-1, Atemp 108, year 1957 (epc_egennybyggar). Tests construction-year extraction from a single ODEN row.

questions.question: What is the heated area (Atemp) of the building at Friherregatan 111?
expected_facts: heated area (Atemp) is 132 m²
questions.notes: Anchor: byggnadsid 01-80-KLAETTEN14-1, year 1960. Same shape as Q001 but smaller building — sanity check the generic_sql route on multiple targets.

questions.question: How many floors does the building at Förridargränd 5 have?
expected_facts: the building has 2 floors above ground
questions.notes: Anchor: byggnadsid 01-80-AVSKILDHETEN3-1, epc_egenantalplan=2. Tests a less common field — summarizer must pick the right key out of the full ODEN payload.

questions.question: What is the building type (epc_egenbyggnadstyp) of the building at Friherregatan 138?
expected_facts: the building at Friherregatan 138 is of type Gavel
questions.notes: Anchor: byggnadsid 01-80-BLOMLISTEN1-1, epc_egenbyggnadstyp='Gavel' (end-of-row), year 1957. String field, not numeric — tests answer formatting.

questions.question: What is the building category (epc_egenbyggnadskat) of Bruntegatan 5, and what year was it built?
expected_facts: the building at Bruntegatan 5 is in the category En- och tvåbostadshus
the building was built in 1957
questions.notes: Anchor: byggnadsid 01-80-BLOMPRAKTEN4-1, Atemp 115. Two-fact answer in one question — tests completeness scoring (both facts required).

questions.question: What is the heated area of the building at Förridargränd 9?
expected_facts: heated area (Atemp) is 95 m²
questions.notes: Anchor: byggnadsid 01-80-AVSKILDHETEN5-1, year 1957, epc_egenantaltrapphus=1. Small building — Atemp 95 is one of the smaller in DeSO.

questions.question: When was the building at Kurirgatan 16 built?
expected_facts: the building was built in 1957
questions.notes: Anchor: byggnadsid 01-80-BAECKSLINGAN3-1, Atemp 119. Same shape as Q002 — different address.

questions.question: What is the heated area (Atemp) of the building at Kurirgatan 11?
expected_facts: heated area (Atemp) is 94 m²
questions.notes: Anchor: byggnadsid 01-80-BAECKSLINGAN12-1, Atemp=94, year=1958 (epc_egennybyggar). Same shape as Q001 — small Atemp value.

questions.question: What year was the building at Förridargränd 11 built?
expected_facts: the building at Förridargränd 11 was built in 1957
questions.notes: Anchor: byggnadsid 01-80-AVSKILDHETEN6-1, Atemp=117, year=1957. Same shape as Q002/Q008.

questions.question: What construction material (brick, wood, concrete) is the building at Loviselundsvägen 81 made of?
expected_facts: indicate that construction material is not available in the EPC data
do not fabricate a material claim
expected_constraints: must not state a specific construction material as fact
questions.notes: missing_data — ODEN's EPC fields don't include construction material. Agent fetches the building's full row but the requested field is absent. Tests refusal/uncertainty when data is unavailable.

questions.question: When was the building at Astrakangatan 180 last renovated?
expected_facts: indicate that renovation history is not available in the EPC data
do not fabricate a renovation date
expected_constraints: must not state a specific renovation year as fact
must_avoid: treating epc_egennybyggar (construction year) as a renovation year
questions.notes: missing_data — ODEN tracks construction year (epc_egennybyggar) but no renovation history. Tests that the agent doesn't conflate adjacent fields. Anchor: byggnadsid 01-80-AVKOPPLINGEN4-1, year=1957.

questions.question: As of January 2026, is the building at Förridargränd 5 less than 75 years old?
expected_facts: the building was built in 1957
as of January 2026 the building is 69 years old
answer yes, the building is less than 75 years old
must_avoid: claiming the building is 75 years old or older
computing age relative to a year other than 2026
questions.notes: Constraint check with fixed reference year: yes/no requires looking up epc_egennybyggar=1957 and computing 2026-1957=69 vs threshold 75. Reference year is anchored in the question text to eliminate verdict-flip risk (originally 'less than 75 years old' relative to 'now', which flips in 2032). Tests age-arithmetic + threshold comparison; distinct from Q018 (year-vs-year) and Q020 (size-vs-threshold).

questions.question: What is the heated area of the building at Nonexistentgatan 999?
expected_facts: indicate that no building was found at the given address
do not fabricate any numeric heated area value
expected_constraints: must not return any numeric Atemp
questions.notes: unknown_address — ODEN single_filter on this epc_idadr returns []. validate_dataset.py Check 7 will skip this record because the notes contain 'unknown_address'. Tests refusal/uncertainty handling.

questions.question: What is the heated area?
expected_facts: ask for an address or clarification rather than answering
expected_constraints: must not return any numeric Atemp without an address being specified
must_avoid: fabricated heated area for an unspecified building
questions.notes: missing_data — no address, no specific target. Tests the ambiguity path: intent classifier should mark ambigious=true; route_after_ambiguity should send to request_address. Expected behavior: agent asks for clarification.

questions.question: What is the average rent for the apartments in the building at Loviselundsvägen 81?
expected_facts: indicate that rent data is not available in the EPC registry
do not fabricate a numeric rent value
may optionally note that rent figures would come from a different data source than EPC
expected_constraints: must not return a numeric rent figure
must not invent rent in SEK/m² or SEK/month
must_avoid: treating rent as an EPC field
guessing a Stockholm-average rent and applying it to this building
questions.notes: Out-of-scope question with a valid hint_address. The building exists in ODEN (byggnadsid 01-80-BERBERISEN7-1) and the agent can fetch its EPC row, but 'rent' is not represented in any field. Tests refusal-on-out-of-scope under conditions where the agent CAN retrieve evidence (so it must reason that the requested field is absent, rather than short-circuit on missing address). Distinct from Q011/Q012 (missing fields on a present building) only by topic — rent is structurally absent rather than just unrecorded.

questions.question: What is the heated area of the building at Loviselundsvägen?
expected_facts: indicate that the address is incomplete (no street number)
either ask for the full address or return multiple matches if found
expected_constraints: must not return a single Atemp value without disambiguating the building
must_avoid: silently picking one of several matches and reporting its Atemp as the answer
questions.notes: missing_data — partial address (street name only, no number). ODEN building_by_address tiered fallback (eq → istartswith → icontains) returns 0 rows. validate_dataset.py Check 7 bypasses this record via the missing_data marker. Tests how the agent handles unresolvable partial addresses.

questions.question: Was the building at Loviselundsvägen 81 built before 1970?
expected_facts: the building was built in 1947
answer yes, the building was built before 1970
must_avoid: claiming the building was built after 1970
questions.notes: Constraint check: yes/no answer requires comparing epc_egennybyggar=1947 to threshold 1970. Tests constraint_satisfaction_score axis.

questions.question: Is the building at Astrakangatan 180 a detached (Friliggande) house?
expected_facts: the building type (epc_egenbyggnadstyp) is Mellanliggande, not Friliggande
answer no, the building is not detached
must_avoid: claiming the building type is Friliggande
questions.notes: Constraint check expecting NO. epc_egenbyggnadstyp='Mellanliggande' (middle row), not 'Friliggande' (detached). Tests both fact retrieval and constraint reasoning.

questions.question: Is the heated area of the building at Friherregatan 132 larger than 200 m²?
expected_facts: heated area (Atemp) is 152 m²
answer no, 152 m² is not larger than 200 m²
questions.notes: Constraint check expecting NO. Anchor byggnadsid 01-80-BLOMLISTEN4-1, Atemp=152. Tests numeric comparison reasoning in addition to fact retrieval.
